findings.claim: A failed runtime pin toggle mutated state.pin_tab and BrowserManager before persisting, so a load/save error returned an error while the live isolation mode had already flipped (torn state).
findings.verified_by: reproduced through the built CLI: failed --no-pin-tab left the daemon unpinned in memory (tab close gave code=None instead of tab_gone) despite the command erroring
findings.fix: persist first, commit state.pin_tab + set_pin_tab only after persistence succeeds (commit 28560b9)
findings.revalidated: post-fix dogfood: failed --no-pin-tab then tab close now yields tab_gone (still pinned in memory)

findings.claim: 8 added lines contain em dashes, flagged as a style violation.
findings.refutation: em dashes are established repo style in code: 12 files on origin/main use them (actions.rs 10, e2e_tests.rs 15, interaction.rs 13). AGENTS.md forbids '--' double-hyphen, not em dashes, and permits emdash sparingly. The universal em-dash gate over-fires against the repo's own convention; kept exempt, did not churn author lines.
